title: Map: Operation GRAND SLAM, 1 May 1960 – proposed and actual U-2 mission routes
description: Map titled "Operation GRAND SLAM, 1 May 1960" with a legend distinguishing a dashed "Proposed mission route" from a solid "Actual mission route." The solid line runs from Peshawar, Pakistan, north past Tyuratam to the Sverdlovsk area; the dashed line continues northwest via Kirov, Kotlas, Plesetsk, Severodvinsk, Kandalaksha and Murmansk to Bodo, Norway. The Ural Mountains, Moscow, the R.S.F.S.R. and Kazakh S.S.R. are labeled; marked Secret NOFORN.
